Denomination: Denarius (Empire). A broken Roman silver denarius of Septimius Severus. Reece period: Period 10 [193-222]. Mint or issue place: Rome. Obverse description: Laureate bust right. Obverse inscription: [IMP] CAE L SEP S[EV PERT AVG] (or similar). Reverse description: Virtus standing left holding victory and spear. Reverse inscription: [VIRT] AVG [TR P COS] (or similar - could be TRPII/COS II)
